hana: Quick heads-up I'm putting together a short release-note for the new adaptive routing beta. Need: a one-line whats-new for the feed, a tiny migration tip for teams with route caching, a curl example for the changelog, and a Known issues note with repro. Will open PR in ~30m and ping for review.

drew: Call out the flag name exactly: adaptive_routing.enabled. Also spell out fallback order: hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-variant (configurable). Ops wants canary plan: 10% for 24h then 50% for 48h.

liam: I'll draft the curl + python snippets. Will keep both very short.

ci-bot: Created PR #6129 (staging preview): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing/preview-6129. Initial linkcheck: 1 404 (/tutorials/legacy-routing).

hana: Added redirect /tutorials/legacy-routing -> /docs/adaptive-routing/migrate and a compact migration tip: "If you use route-level caching, pre-warm KV or ramp traffic slowly." Draft blurb below, please copy-edit.

hana: ```
What's new: Adaptive routing (beta)
- Opt-in per route: adaptive_routing.enabled = true. Prefers lower-cost variants and automatically falls back to compatible variants.
- Canary: 10% traffic for 24h, then 50% for 48h.
Known issues:
- On some T4 hosts a transient ~5-12ms latency increase at seq=512 can occur while the KV cache warms. Repro: ./tools/bench --seq 512 --target routing-canary (staging). Mitigation: pin variant or disable adaptive_routing for latency-sensitive routes.

Curl (changelog-friendly):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rodeo-3","prompt":"Write a haiku","routing":{"adaptive_routing":{"enabled":true}}}'
```

qa-jen: I'll rerun linkcheck after you add the redirect. Also will add a short one-line changelog feed entry post-merge.

ci-bot: Linkcheck (preview-6129)  0 404s, 0 lint errors. Full: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/6129/linkcheck

hana: Thanks all, merging in ~10m. Please watch the release-index rendering and ping if the changelog block escapes weirdly. If anything regresses we'll revert and ship a patch. :thumbsup:
